scope: 26 articles in the first two frozen BAS cards and 20 previously inspected developer-labelled same-task pairs
limitations: All pair judgements are from one developer and the held-out pairs have already been inspected in earlier experiments.
Valid source sentence IDs do not establish that the generated facet is semantically correct.
A shared research task does not prove a single narrow technical mechanism or a weak signal.
No production change or independent accuracy claim is permitted from this pilot.
